title: Extract Philip Morris 10-K Currency Translation
goal: Using SEC EDGAR, open Philip Morris International Inc.'s annual report on Form 10-K for fiscal year 2015. In that filing, find the line item "Currency translation adjustments (in the statement of comprehensive earnings)" and report its value for each of these periods: 2015, 2014 and 2013. Report numbers exactly as printed (keep the filing's units; use negative numbers for values shown in parentheses). If you cannot find the filing or the line item, set found=false and do not guess.

found.description: false if the filing or the line item could not be found

units.description: units as printed in the filing, e.g. 'in millions'

filing_url.description: URL of the 10-K document the values came from

output.notes: The fiscal 2015 Form 10-K was found, but the requested line item has no single printed value. On page 84, the Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Earnings show 'Change in currency translation adjustments:' as a heading with blank value cells. Its component rows are 'Unrealized gains (losses)' (2015: -2248; 2014: -1746; 2013: -1876) and '(Gains)/losses transferred to earnings' (2015: -1; 2014: -5; 2013: -12). No component was selected or total inferred.
